beta.notes:
New in this version:
• Buddy now installs just for you on Windows, so updates stop asking for permission. If an older copy is still installed for everyone on this computer, Buddy offers Remove it or Not now. Once it is removed, other teachers on that computer install Buddy for themselves.
• Checking, downloading and preparing an update all happen in the update window. Downloads have a real Cancel, and an update you put off comes back through the banner.
• The grading page's bottom band is one paper surface. Page tools sit on their own tab, and a thumbnail's grip shows only while the pointer is over it.
• The grade comment sits in the grading row and grows as you type, then folds when you click away. On the Chat tab it waits as a dashed bubble until you choose Post to thread or Keep with the grade.
• Task has its own tab between Chat and Rubric, and Chat runs the full height of the panel with the reply box at the bottom.
• The demo tour brings each step's screen forward and hands you a worksheet to drag on the drop step. Its slides always play.
• Automatic pre-grading now skips only work already graded in Schoology, and pre-grades everything else in any learning period. Turn it on or off from the To-do menu.
• A pre-grade with any model output shows it with a banner instead of stopping. One that does stop says why and what to do next.
• Reading & AI: click anywhere on a None, OCR only or OCR + AI card. Auto-configure says what this computer can run and suggests a model that fits.
• Grade and Choose work the same way across learning periods, and a student's row unfolds out of its header as one motion. Work not yet graded opens in Grade, and a missing upload offers Check upload.
• The Appearance, PDF output and Schoology settings pages are tidier, with matching controls and aligned rows.
• The welcome wizard's folder step shows the records it found as one clear card, and the setup screens share one look.

Fixes:
• Up and down arrows on number boxes respond when clicked.
• The window no longer freezes briefly at a session's first message, and report card progress stays smooth while a job runs.
• Long student names in To-do shorten with an ellipsis instead of being cut off.
• Checking an update's signature no longer flashes a console window.

stable.notes:
New in this version:
• Read the full assignment instructions and preview rubric criteria directly beneath each option. Confirm a match once to remember it for other papers from the same assignment; choose the rubric separately for each student's work.
• Reading & AI now has a Test connection button, a visible model dropdown, and a count of the models found on the selected computer.

Fixes:
• When AI is unavailable, newly generated report-card comments use course-specific practice guidance, including age-appropriate early literacy and math wording.
• PCA settings have consistent buttons, readable narrow-window layouts, and improved dark-mode fields. Advanced connection settings opens and scrolls to the right section; the temporary-file test is clearly labelled under Troubleshooting.
• Changed assignment instructions, rubric criteria, or source worksheets prompt a review of saved option/rubric matches. Attachment reordering does not change a confirmed match.
• The demo starts on LP1 and guides you through the real app controls. Older demos upgrade to include the Science sample needed to finalize the four-subject packet.
• Tour instructions stay clear of the learning-period and To-do menus, including in smaller windows. Keep exploring preserves your practice work.
• The demo asks you to match the grade and date printed on the worksheet, explains corrections, and offers a zoom reminder. Verify waits for the matching choices.
• Request revision appears beside the grade choices only for samples linked to a downloaded Schoology submission. Grade tools wrap to fit narrow windows with larger text.
